release_notes: Upgraded to Version 0.2.5 (License activation is now live: the app verifies serial keys against the production license server with Ed25519-signed responses; one PC per key with self-service deactivation from Settings; critical update installer fix: the app now closes cleanly via the main window shutdown path instead of raising AttributeError, the swap batch retries against transient file locks and force-kills if the wait loop times out; full user documentation added at docs/USER_GUIDE.md)
